body: the validation of torch.gather and Tensor.gather need to be added.
I expect it follows the rules of broadcasting like most other ops right?
yes，what I mean is that we need to add constraint relationships in accordance with the documentation.
I'm not sure what you mean by that. The doc (explicit + implicit broadcasting) is correct wrt to the error checking that is done right?

@albanD In the documentation of torch.gather it states "Note that input and index do not broadcast against each other." On the CPU/GPU side there is currently broadcasting. If the intended behavior is to broadcast, I can update the documentation. If the intended behavior is not to broadcast, I can add a validation check. Please let me know what you would prefer. I can also make a corresponding change in https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/157419.

We should update the doc to match the implementation in both cases!
Changing the behavior of the function itself would be BC-breaking.
Also "broadcasting happening" is the default, so no need to mention it explicitly.

Thanks for looking into this.
